messages:
mira: Quick status check — shipping window next Tue. Need owners/blocks for Optimize Toolkit items: quantization recommendations, batching/caching, and regression alerts. @alex @chris @juan please call out anything blocking.

alex: PR with quant recs is up (https://git.redwood/ri/optkit/pulls/452). Benchmarks look good on A100-80G; T4 shows ~3% quality regression with int8. My proposal: default to int8 on HGX/A100 fleets, fallback to fp16 for T4/OEM nodes. I added a config flag `model.quant.fallback=t4:fp16`. Need an owner to sign off for T4 behavior.

chris: Batching refactor (batcher_v2) merged into staging, still flaky in CI for large seq lengths. Reproducer pasted below:

```bash
export BATCH_SIZE=8
pytest tests/test_batching.py::test_large_seq_batching --maxfail=1 -q
```

Cause looks like race in batch window flush — I'm on it, should have fix by EOD.

juan: Heads up — nightly eval triggered a regression alert on embedding consistency for model `opt-mid-3` after applying quant recs. Drift is small but crosses our alert threshold for some benchmarks. I opened INC-1021 and pinned the failing eval set. Rolling back quant stage for that model in staging now. Need someone to triage eval diffs (maybe @alex?).

sasha: Ownership clarification: I'll own rollout gating and canary plan for Optimize Toolkit. Mira, can you confirm SLA/lattice for gating? I can run a dedicated canary pool and shadow traffic if we want.

mira: Confirming SLA targets: hosted p95 < 250ms token latency, dedicated p95 < 300ms for this rollout. Gate criteria: no regression alerts > 1% on our critical eval set, and no more than 2% increase in cost/token for high-throughput paths.

mira: Action items -> alex: confirm T4 fallback config and add a test matrix entry; chris: fix flaky batch flush and push CI green; juan: triage INC-1021 and report top 3 offending prompts; sasha: run canary plan Wed and report metrics; I'll update tracking doc and notify PMs.

mira: tagging the tracking doc: https://docs.redwood.com/optkit/ship-01 (updates incoming).

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for Wed 10:00 UTC in dedicated pool `alpha-2` with 5% traffic shadowing. Will post canary-start and canary-end pings.

mira: thanks everyone :thumbsup: If anything slips, drop a quick ping here so we can escalate.
